Name: Phineas
Dialog: D'you know what day it is today, gang? It's a special one.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, my calendar says it's Bread Bowl Hot Tub da—

Name: Phineas and the gang
Dialog: Groan.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (throws calendar away, sarcastically) Oh, okay. Let's focus on what Phineas and Ferb wanna do. We never do that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids! We're heading to the park for Danville Day. I've got pie!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And the Mayor's giving a grand speech.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we'll meet you there!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right, gang, Danville Day! How can we crank this party up a notch?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (scoffs) Good luck with that. There is already a grand speech.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I dunno, there might be a couple notches up to which we can crank it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nothing says "Danville Day" like doonkelberry muffins. Uh, Norm, can you bring me the thing I just printed?

Name: Norm
Dialog: The recipe or the essay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Essay? (takes paper) Oh, Vanessa's applying for college! (sighs) They grow up so fast. (reading) "The Most Positive Role Model in My Life, by Vanessa Doofenshmirtz." Se—See, look, Norm. She wrote about me.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm programmed to show interest.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, here it is. (continues reading) "Charismatic, inventive, beloved, should be leader of the entire Tri-State Area. My dear... Uncle Roger, the Mayor"? Wait. What? Why would she choose my brother over me?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Dad?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Gasp, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, uh, oh, hi, Vanessa. Nothing to see here. Just hangin' out.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whatever. I'm headed to the park to watch Uncle Roger's speech. You wanna come with?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh! Roger, Roger, Roger. Okay, fine. I just gotta take care of a few things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ready.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we have intel that Doof is headed to the Danville Day celebration, which Roger is hosting.

Name: Carl
Dialog: He's giving a grand speech.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't let Doof ruin it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Did you just bring me here to remind me how great my brother is?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) Don't be ridiculous, Dad. Just find us a good spot, yeah? I'll be right back. I smell Slushy Dawg.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now where's the best view? Grassy knoll? Book depository? Ooh, a jungle gym! I don't know why they call it a "jungle gym". It's not very jungly, but I do love a slide!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever they build is gonna disappear. Mysterious Force, why must you be so cruel?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Incredible, Ferb! Wait'll Candace gets a load of this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, and get a load of that I shall.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That should keep those kids away. (climbs up the spiral slide) From up here, I'll have a clear view.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! Uh, uh, it's not what it looks like. I'm...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I guess it is what it looks like. So, I'm-I'm having some trouble. Little help? (He holds out his hand but then ties Perry up to the spiral slide with the caution tape.) Ha ha! Improvised trap! Anyway, I'm here to teach Vanessa a lesson. Here, look. She thinks Roger is her role model. And aside from the strong jaw and the dazzling smile, what does he got? Just a sparkling personality, that's all. And it got me thinking: What if I made an inator to give Roger my personality? 'Cause my personality doesn't sparkle, not even a little bit. Behold, my Dooflicate-inator! With this, I'll make Roger a cheap imitation of me, therefore, I'll be Vanessa's role model by default! By default, my favorite way to win!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Welcome to our Danville Day celebration!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Prepare to be Dooflicated!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: His dazzling smile can't be that reflective.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Drusselstinian accent) Extra onions, extra evil! (laughs maniacally)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (taking the dog) Dunno what Candace sees in that guy. (takes a bite) Mmm.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Cut back to Doof.)'

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, wait for him to close his mouth...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Nice award-winning smile!

Name: Roger
Dialog: You don't have to remind me. You gave me an award for that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great work, Ferb! These suits will help us build a continuous carnival ride through the whole city! How much fun is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) And nothing is more fun... than EVIL! But why stop at Danville? I know what we're going to do today! Take over the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, Candace the Sister, you're just in time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: In time for what? Talking weird and hunching over like a praying mantis?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) No, for the beholding!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The bewhating?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) Let me explain through a brief flashback and not-so-brief monologue about my childhood!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your childhood? You mean your nowhood. You are a child!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) Nevertheless, our long-necked nemesis, your thwarting days are numbered!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold! The fun-inators! Get ready, Danville, for the ride of your life! Y'know, cuz it'll last a lifetime. It's a trap! And with no one to stop us, the Tri-State Area will be ours!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Happy Danville Day! Join the fun! Or else!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or else? Like, what do you-- What do you mean "or else"? (gets on her bike) And again, what's with the accents?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Uh, why are these restraints so tight?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a trap! Remember to smile for the picture! (evil laugh)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Are you a fan of my... fan? (evil laugh)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cackles)

Name: Man
Dialog: Make it stop!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why? You're on a... roll! (evil laugh)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Doesn't this feel like old times, Ferb? Really takes me back to when I was a boy. To last summer.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, what are you doing?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, Candace the Sister! How predictable. And by "predictable", of course, I mean, "COMPLETELY DICTABLE!!!!" Do you care to join the fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Fun"? These people are trapped!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Candace the Sister!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop calling me that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know you can't contain your excitement, so let me contain it for you!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) Curse you, Candace the Sister!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for staying trapped for so long, Perry the Platypus. I... I really needed to vent about Vanessa's essay. This was nice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom, Phineas and Ferb have turned evil!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Drusselsteinian accent) How wonderful, Candace the Daughter! (laughs evilly) Almond brittle pie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (backs away) Oh, no, not you, too! Jeremy! Jeremy, I need your help!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, Candace the Girlfriend! Doonkelberry dawg?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Oh, no! It's everywhere!

Name: Old man
Dialog: Ow! Hey!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, slow down, girl! Are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa, you're you! Everyone's talking in weird accents. My brothers are scheming to take over, I think, (imitating Doof) "the entire Tri-State Area" (normal voice) with inators!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, did you just say "inators"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) I don't usually like to get involved with this stuff, but if there's an inator, there's a self-destruct button. There's always a self-destruct button. That'll take care of it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That easy? Wait, how do you—You know what? No time. Gotta stop 'em.

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: (spoken in rhythm) Dink Winkerson here,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Straight out of white collar prison!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: I'm the man on the street

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Telling you what is and what isn't!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Giant robot takeover,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: I think you better run,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Or you may be forced to have

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Non-consensual fun!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, the Tri-State Area has been taken over! Stop Doof immediately and...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh. You already got him. So it's somebody else? What kind of evil mastermind would... Heh heh. Not our problem. Monogram out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) There's the self-destruct button! But how'm I gonna...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-uh-uh! Not so fast, my nosy little nemesis!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No, I have to stop them! They're destroying the city with... fun!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: First the Tri-State Area, next... the world!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can I get up there? (gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as if in prayer) Oh, Mysterious Force, if I ever needed you to destroy the boys' inventions, it's now. If you can hear me, please answer my call!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mysterious Force, you work in mysterious ways.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, that was fun, right? Happy Danville Day, everyone!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, you okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hi, Vanessa. So tell me, how was Roger, your "role model".

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, your essay, th-the college application? I read the whole thing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I only wrote that because namedropping the Mayor would get me in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you mean calling Roger your role model was just part of a diabolical scheme? (wells up in tears and hugs his daughter) That's my little girl!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (normal voice) Who puts almond brittle in a pie?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (normal voice) Ew! Who puts doonkelberry on a dawg?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (normal voice) Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (normal voice) Wow, Ferb! What did we do today?

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: (spoken in rhythm) Dink Winkerson here,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Straight out of white collar prison!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: I'm the man on the street

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Telling you what is and what isn't!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Giant robot takeover,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: I think you better run,

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Or you may be forced to have

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Non-consensual fun!
